carouselRuntime.renderedRule: slides live in <template class="sd-carousel__template"> in page.html (6 nodes). The runtime clones them into the light DOM as direct children of <sd-carousel> and appends ONE extra node that duplicates the current head, giving data-max-length=7 nodes from 6 unique items.
carouselRuntime.controlsPosition: the .sd-35 controls bar is the LAST light-DOM child of <sd-carousel> in the live DOM (authored FIRST in page.html) and is position:absolute, so DOM order does not matter

step.trigger: setInterval every 3000ms while is-playing, plus click on .sd-36 (prev) / .sd-43 (next)
step.phase1: runtime stamps data-animatingNext (next) or data-animatingPrev (prev) on EVERY .sd-carousel__slide and writes transition-duration: 0.6s inline (data-sd-carousel-duration hook). Start frame sampled at t=808ms: transform matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0) on all 7 slides.
step.phase2: the sliced rule .sd-root [data-animatingNext].sd-20__content { transform: translateX(-100%) } drives all 7 slides left by exactly one slide width over 600ms with cubic-bezier(0.58, 0.21, 0.41, 0.96). Sampled transforms across one step @1440 (100ms polling): -46.6618 -> -139.263 -> -304.167 -> -452.38 -> -515.476 -> -534.922 (= translateX(-100%) of the 534.922px slide).
step.phase3: on completion the runtime rotates the light DOM one position (head node removed, a fresh clone of the new head appended), removes data-animatingNext and resets transition-duration to 0s. Rest state: transform none on every slide, transition-duration 0s.
step.prevIsMirror: data-animatingPrev -> transform: translateX(100%), DOM rotates the other way. Verified: one .sd-43 click moved head recruit->huuuu, one .sd-36 click restored it.

hoverStop.evidence: hover over slide 2's for 7000ms (>2 intervals) -> DOM order string identical before and after. Releasing the hover restarts the 3000ms interval.

playToggle.before: is-playing present; aria-label "Stop automatic slide show"; .sd-39 (pause wrapper) display flex; .sd-41 (play wrapper) display none
playToggle.after: is-playing removed; aria-label "Play automatic slide show"; .sd-39 display none; .sd-41 display flex (background #222222, glyph #f7f7f7). No advance during 4000ms while paused.

appear.finding: the 7 [data-appear-manual] nodes in this section are exactly the 7 .sd-carousel__slide nodes. They carry NO `appear` class, computed opacity 1, translate none, transition-property transform only. NO element in main > .sd-13 has an `appear` class in page.html. There is NO reveal animation in this section.

hoverRules.source: __cloneSnap.rules('main > .sd-13') -> 22 hits, all from the inline origin sheet; identical text to the sliced CSS.
hoverRules..sd-20__content__sd-1:hover .sd-20__cont: filter: brightness(90%); scale: 1.03; transition-duration: 500ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.07, 0.83, 0.41, 1.04)
hoverRules..sd-20__content__sd-4:hover .sd-20__cont: color: #f7f7f7; rotate: -45deg; translate: 16px -16px (rest: rotate -45deg; translate none)

themeClasses.note: the three text nodes and the slide labels carry theme-* classes whose rules live in app/studio-base.css at specificity 0,3,0 (.sd-root .text.theme-XXXX) and therefore BEAT the section rules (.sd-root .sd-NN = 0,2,0) for font-size / line-height. Do NOT drop the theme classes from the markup.

390.visibleSlides: 1 centered + slivers of its neighbours; the track is justify-content:center so the 7-node flex line overflows 966.15px on each side and node index 3 (0-based) lands at x 32.6

768.visibleSlides: 2 full + 8% of the third (694px content box / 333.117px step)

1440.buttons: 58x26, radius 24px, padding 4px 20px, border 1px solid #222222, bg #ffffff, glyph 16px Material Icons #222222
1440.visibleSlides: 2 full + 61% of the third (1366px content box / 534.922px step)

scroll.finding: no scroll-driven state; .sd-13 has no sticky/fixed descendant. .sd-35 is position:absolute inside .sd-20 and scrolls with the section.

nodes.note: arrow pair inside the 16x16 overflow-hidden window
